title: 第1664章 金素梅追来了第1663章 获得极品火灵石
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 金素梅一头雾水中，刚才扶桑渊里的异变虽然只是一刹那间，但却没有躲过自己的神识。
一定是死淫贼在偷我扶桑渊里的宝贝呢。
虽然大长老再三嘱咐，死淫贼是金乌族的老祖，一定要以礼相待，毕恭毕敬。
但金素梅一想起郑元偷窥自己沐浴，还让自己叫他老祖，还吃自己的豆腐……气就不打一处来。
也不知道本族老祖是不是脑袋进水了，让这么一个淫贼当金乌族的老祖。
金素梅一跺脚，身形一晃飞进了扶桑林中。
此时郑元脸上露出一丝微笑，神魂再次壮大，神核又大了一圈，连带着金刚不坏之身再次晋级了，并且还得到了极品火灵髓。
不愧是上古隐族，底蕴还真是渊厚。
郑元顺着通道继续前行，同时开启了洞察之眼和破妄真瞳。
一路上漫天金乌元素充斥在空气里，随着不断吸入丹田里，郑元周身金色纹路变得更加耀眼夺目。
一个时辰过后，前方的通道越来越宽阔。
就在下一刻，郑元停住了脚步，那就是前方还有一道巨大的封印。
“也不知道封印背后有什么？”
郑元一拳打了过去。
嗡！
封印瞬间发出阵阵嗡鸣声，金色符文全部都亮了起来。
“咦，居然还是上古封印，还很玄奥。”
郑元刚才那一拳犹如泥牛入海，没有一丝波澜。
要知道，以自己如今的境界，随便一拳都有上百万斤之力。
郑元不信邪的再次一拳轰了过去。
轰隆隆！
第二次重拳裹挟滚滚金乌真火，势如崩山裂海，狠狠砸在封印光幕之上。
瞬间，漫天古老符文剧烈震颤，金光滔天，整座地底洞窟剧烈摇晃，碎石狂落，火浪翻涌。
可这道上古封印依旧纹丝不动，所有恐怖力道尽数被吞得干干净净。
郑元眉头一皱，看来用蛮力是不可能破解这封印了。
洞察之眼开启！
破妄真瞳开启！
乾坤无极镜也被祭了出来。
一刻钟后，郑元双目神光洞彻万古，层层叠叠的封印纹路在他眼底无所遁形。
那些看似厚重玄奥的上古禁制，瞬间被看穿所有破绽与阵眼脉络。
“原来如此，看着挺吓唬人的，实则只是一些阵法堆砌，徒有其表罢了。”
郑元嗤笑一声，不再用蛮力硬轰。
content_en:
Jin Sumei was confused. Although the change in Fusang Yuan just happened for a moment, it did not escape her consciousness.
It must be some evil thief who is stealing my treasure from Fusang Yuanli.
Although the great elder repeatedly told him that the dead thief is the ancestor of the Golden Crow tribe, he must treat him with courtesy and respect.
But when Jin Sumei thought of Zheng Yuan spying on her bathing, asking her to call him ancestor, and eating her own tofu... she became angry.
I don’t know if the ancestor of this tribe has water in his head, allowing such a lewd thief to become the ancestor of the Golden Crow tribe.
Jin Sumei stamped her feet and flew into the hibiscus forest.
At this time, a smile appeared on Zheng Yuan's face, his soul grew stronger again, his core became bigger again, he was promoted again with his indestructible body, and he also got the best fire essence.
As expected of the ancient Hidden Clan, their heritage is truly profound.
Zheng Yuan continued to move forward along the passage, opening the Eye of Insight and the True Eye of Deception at the same time.
Along the way, the air was filled with golden crow elements. As he continued to breathe into his Dantian, the golden lines on Zheng Yuan's body became more dazzling.
An hour later, the passage ahead became wider and wider.
The next moment, Zheng Yuan stopped, there was a huge seal ahead.
"I don't know what's behind the seal?"
Zheng Yuan punched him.
Buzz!
The seal buzzed instantly, and all the golden runes lit up.
"Hey, it's actually an ancient seal, and it's very mysterious."
Zheng Yuan's punch just now was like a mud cow entering the sea, without any ripples.
You know, with his current state, any punch can have a force of millions of kilograms.
Zheng Yuan punched him again in disbelief.
Boom!
The second heavy fist wrapped around the rolling Golden Crow True Fire, with the force of breaking a mountain and splitting the sea, and hit the sealing light curtain hard.
In an instant, the ancient runes all over the sky trembled violently, golden light surged into the sky, the entire underground cave shook violently, gravel fell wildly, and waves of fire surged.
But this ancient seal remained motionless, and all the terrifying power was swallowed up cleanly.
Zheng Yuan frowned. It seemed that it was impossible to break the seal with brute force.
The eyes of insight are open!
The true pupil that breaks the illusion is opened!
The Universe Wuji Mirror was also sacrificed.
A quarter of an hour later, Zheng Yuan's eyes were filled with divine light, and the layers of seal patterns were unmistakable in his eyes.
Those seemingly thick and mysterious ancient restrictions were instantly seen through all the flaws and formations.
"So that's it. It looks quite scary, but in fact it's just a collection of formations, just superficial."
Zheng Yuan sneered and stopped attacking with brute force.
title_en: Chapter 1664 Jin Sumei is chasing me Chapter 1663 Obtaining the best fire spirit stone
